commands.label: Compile and run an isolated evaluator for the single typed return using the genuine WitcherScript parser
commands.stdout:
Native tree: (func_decl name: (ident) params: (func_params) return_type: (type_annot type_name: (ident)) definition: (func_def (return_stmt (literal_string))))
Typed return: Hello, World!

Cargo.toml.content_utf8:
[package]
name = "witcher_greeting"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
tree-sitter = "=0.20.10"
tree-sitter-witcherscript = {git = "https://github.com/SpontanCombust/tree-sitter-witcherscript.git", rev = "31dae31b5c0165547ba1ec63c1467169ab0020fb"}
serde_json = "1"

toolchain: WIDE pinned native tree-sitter WitcherScript grammar and typed constant-return check
reproduction_command: cargo run --quiet (recorded exact upstream parser dependency)
semantic_scope: The compatible native AST parser recognized the unchanged, parameterless callable. The semantic probe resolved the single reachable return and evaluated its string literal against the declared type, yielding the exact greeting.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
